lo-cis Defensionis Caluini, in postrema ea-

Quartum caput Arminiani sic expli-
cant ut dicant, Fidem, quam Gratia Dei
in hominibus generat, nusquam esse
tantam & tam firmam, quin excidere atque
interire possit. Adeo ut nonnulli electi,
qui in fide non perseuerant, fiant repro-
bi, nonnulli reprobi[?] qui in increduli-
tate non permanent, euadant electi. Sic
neminem de sua salute vere certum aut
persuasum esse contendunt.
Orthodoxi contra firmiter credunt, fi-
dem, postquam semel electis data est, in
iis firmam manere, & inconcussam, &

page.notes: The right margin shows note fragments cut off by the scan edge; they are not legible and are not transcribed. Doubtful readings are marked [?]: "earum" (line end "ea-" with "rum" unclear), and "reprobi" in the second "nonnulli" phrase. Printed "caufis" is copied as seen. Printed "vt", "vsque", "vere", "ijs" and similar forms were normalised per the u/v and i/j rule, and long s is written as s.
